summary.en-US: Make Gmail look and work like Haiku's BeMail: a BeOS-style toolbar, Tracker message list, yellow window tabs and Haiku controls.

description.en-US:
Turn Gmail into a native-looking Haiku (BeOS) mail client, modelled on Haiku's BeMail and Beam and on Haiku's interface guidelines.

• Actions in the window they act on, as in BeMail and Tracker: an open message has Reply, Reply All, Forward, Archive, Trash, Junk, Unread, Print, Previous and Next; a message list has Archive, Trash, Junk and Read/Unread for the selected messages. Each button presses Gmail's own control, so Gmail still does the work.
• Tracker-style queries: one click runs a saved search (Unread, Starred, Attachments, or your own - save any Gmail search with a name and a picture). Your queries sync through Firefox Sync.
• App toolbar with New, Check Mail and Google Drive, in Haiku's icons.
• Yellow window tabs over the message pane and the compose window, with a working close box.
• Tracker-style message list: 22px rows, column headers, Haiku status icons and stars.
• BeMail compose window: To and Subject labels, the Send row and formatting strip at the top, minimise and zoom boxes on the tab.
• Haiku controls throughout: bevelled push buttons, sunken text fields, radio buttons, checkboxes, menus and tab views.
• Sender pictures and compact summary cards for invitations, bills and orders; a resizable folder panel; a status bar with the unread count and position.
• Gmail extras with no BeOS counterpart are hidden: the apps grid, Gemini, Chat and Meet, and the Material ripples.

Everything happens in your browser. The add-on collects no data and makes no network requests. Besides running on mail.google.com it uses the browser's add-on storage, only to keep your saved queries.

Works with Gmail's English interface and default inbox layout. Open source (MIT): https://github.com/ojdorson/haiku-theme-for-gmail

Not affiliated with Google or Haiku, Inc. Gmail is a trademark of Google LLC. The icons are Haiku's, used under the MIT License.

release_notes.en-US: Firefox support: the Haiku (BeOS) theme for Gmail, now as a Firefox add-on. Also tidier compose recipients, right-aligned coloured subject labels and exact action-bar hover areas.
